[r,'پردہ داراں نوں علمدار دا سہارا اے','موت غازی دی کیویں پاک سہنی سہ گئیاں',r],

def render(groups,numbers,prefix=''):

assert offset==len(roman)==26

item.text:
Reconstructed all 26 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and retained the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, adjusting only capitalization and stanza formatting. The Punjabi grammar supports updating the language metadata to `pa-Arab`.

I grouped the verses into an opening and five stanzas, preserving every repetition. The readings of “Pak Sehni” (پاک سہنی) and “Raiyaan” (رائیاں) remain tentative. Only the selected lyric changed, and `git diff --check` passed.
